paths.summary_en: Learn the language, environments, dependencies, typing, and tests that reliable Python work depends on.
paths.summary_zh: 掌握语言基础、环境、依赖、类型与测试，为可靠的 Python 项目打好根基。

paths.summary_en: Build typed services and applications that connect Python logic to users and other systems.
paths.summary_zh: 构建有类型约束的服务和应用，把 Python 逻辑连接到用户与其他系统。

paths.summary_en: Turn repeatable work into maintainable scripts, browser workflows, and data pipelines.
paths.summary_zh: 把重复工作变成可维护的脚本、浏览器工作流和数据管道。

paths.summary_en: Learn tools, structured output, state, evaluation, and the safety boundaries of agent systems.
paths.summary_zh: 理解工具调用、结构化输出、状态、评测以及 Agent 系统的安全边界。

resources.title: The Python Tutorial

resources.title: Python Packaging User Guide

resources.title: FastAPI documentation
